name: cache-timer
description: Status-line countdown to prompt cache expiry, with optional keepwarm or auto-handoff

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: default: show only. keepwarm: ping 1 min before expiry. auto-handoff: start with the handoff button on (writes .claude/HANDOFF.md 1 min before expiry, after any keepwarm pings).

maxKeepwarmPings.title: Max keepwarm pings while idle
maxKeepwarmPings.description: Each ping re-reads the whole context. Stops after this many with no real turn.
